name: effect-ink-drip
title: Ink Adhesion
description: Một giọt mực rơi xuống kệ, bẹp ra và loang tới mép kệ có rung nhẹ, rồi ở mép một giọt mới phình ra, đứt cổ, rơi xuống bể mực tạo gợn sóng.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Drop r11 falls 0.3-0.75 s (power1.in) stretching to 1.38 tall; on contact squashes to about 54x7 in 0.12 s power2.out, then spreads to the shelf edge in 0.7 s power2.out with a 2.5 px × e^(−6 t) × sin(24 t) wobble. 1.4-2.0 s a drip forms at the edge (r8, neck 2.6 px thinning), detaches at 2.12 s, falls into a pool (2.12-2.45 s power1.in) and makes ripples 5 px decaying e^(−2.4 t) spreading 130 px/s (pool +5 px). Fade 3.45-3.95 s. Params: fall (0.45 s, power1.in) · squash (54x7) · spread (0.7 s) · drip (1.4-2.12 s) · ripple (5 px). Fall 0.3–0.75 s (power1.in, stretching to 1.38), squash to 54 × 7, spread to the shelf edge in 0.7 s with a 2.5 × e^(−6 t) × sin 24 t wobble, a drip forms 1.4–2.0 s, drops at 2.12 s, ripples in the pool.
